name: Joltini
look: a V-shaped martini glass full of glowing neon-yellow liqueur with a lightning-bolt lemon twist and an olive antenna
entry: Joltini vibrates at high frequencies, creating static sparks along its rim. One sip of its electrified nectar can keep a trainer awake for three days.
how: Wild: uncommon in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
It learns Zest Shock at level 17.
